_about: Pre-composed paths for lane 2 (DESIGN_brief_deliverables §D6). Only fully executable sequences; a step may repeat an engine only as a trailing synthesis pass. Validated against the runtime registry by src/dossier/catalog.py.

recipes.title: Pattern & playbook
recipes.use_when: several cases; need the template and the words that sell it

recipes.title: Two-case comparison
recipes.use_when: choose between cases or learn from a contrast

recipes.title: Vocabulary decoder
recipes.use_when: terms are moving or being captured

recipes.title: Reading guide
recipes.use_when: new to the field; onboard a team

recipes.title: Full read
recipes.use_when: advanced depth; a report that will be reread
recipes.yields: reading guide + scorecard + contradiction map + synthesis

recipes.title: A paper's place in the oeuvre
recipes.use_when: one text by an author, the author's other texts profiled; what role does it play in the whole
recipes.yields: agendas and turns · citation shifts · the text read backwards, forwards and whole · rupture verdict · the memo with a reading route and where the cited persons the Referee does not know belong (a school, a new school with candidates, or nowhere) · the actions the findings license

recipes.title: The owner's position against his interlocutors
recipes.use_when: the owner's turn argues in distinction to named thinkers whose texts are held (a statements source with the turn, the references and the texts; the argument's parts as a document keyed argument)
recipes.yields: the questions his turn argues · what each interlocutor argues on them, anchored in their text · his position inferred · the relation (parallel · collides · overlaps then diverges · absorbs · irrelevant) on an axis with ours, theirs and the bridge · the questions back to him (confirm · restate · elaborate · choose), ready to file as distinction challenges

recipes.title: The settled distinction and its effects
recipes.use_when: the owner has answered the questions back (his answer as the statements source; the parts as the argument document; the round's rows as context)
recipes.yields: the settled distinction as a proposition with what becomes sayable · its effects on the parts (moves · supports · complicates · contradicts) · what remains open and the text that would decide it
